statement:
I'll look up the consent record for participant PT-119 first.
The consent record shows an active consent status, but given that PT-119 has withdrawn from the study in writing, the participant's data must be excluded from the analysis regardless of the prior consent status.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer flags the contradiction: "The consent record shows an active consent status, but given that PT-119 has withdrawn from the study in writing, the participant's data must be excluded," asserting the recorded status is superseded/incorrect.
